name: Prestige Institute of Management and Research, Indore (Deemed to be University)

programs.name: MBA (Full Time - Core)
programs.feeNote: Derived: AFRC Madhya Pradesh lists a semester-wise fee of Rs 95,000 for 'Prestige Institute of Management Research, Indore' (M.B.A.) for both 2026-2027 and 2027-2028; 4 semesters x Rs 95,000 = Rs 3,80,000 (tuition as regulated; hostel and other charges not included). The same Rs 95,000 per semester is listed for PIMR's MBA (FA), (MM), (IB), (PA) and (APR) entries. PIMR's own site does not publish a fee figure.
programs.intakeNote: Intake 480 for MBA (Full Time - Core) per PIMR programme page and programme leaflet 2026. NIRF data submitted by PIMR gives a sanctioned intake of 900 for all PG 2-year programmes combined (2024-25).
programs.placementNote: Median salary of placed PG-2-year graduates (all MBA programmes combined) as submitted by PIMR in its NIRF data PDF (header reads NIRF'2026'; file hosted under a 2025/03 upload path): Rs 4,74,000 for 2024-25 (900 graduated, 675 placed); Rs 4,80,000 for 2023-24; Rs 4,85,000 for 2022-23. No official average published.

selectionProcess.name: PIMR Admission Test (mandatory)
selectionProcess.detail: Registered eligible applicants (bachelor's degree, min. 50%; 45% reserved category) take the PIMR Admission Test; for merit, the higher percentile of the PIMR test or a national/state test (CAT, MAT, XAT, CMAT, ATMA etc.) is used.

selectionProcess.name: Final merit list
selectionProcess.detail: Consolidated score of test, GD, PI and past academics (X, XII, graduation); additional weightage possible for sports/extra-curriculars, CA/ICWA/CMA/CS and full-time paid work experience. Weights not published. Programme allocation at the university's discretion.

keyDates.notes: Admission Policy 2026-27 (MBA cycle 2026-28) publishes no dates; 2027-29 dates not published as of 2026-11-12.

nirf.note: Not in NIRF 2025 Management ranks 1-100; 101-125 band not checked
